'''''Aechmea calyculata''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Bromeliaceae]] family.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:121581-1|title= Aechmea calyculata (É.Morren) Baker|author=<!--Not stated-->|date=n.d.|website=Plants of the World Online|publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|access-date=July 22, 2020}}</ref>

==Distribution==
The [[bromeliad]] is [[endemic]] to the [[Atlantic Forest|Atlantic Forest biome]] (''Mata Atlantica Brasileira'').<ref>[http://www.dpi.inpe.br/referata/arq/22_Rafael_Bromelias/Bromelia_Mata_Atlantica.pdf DPI.inpe.br: "BROMELIACEAE da MATA ATLÂNTICA BRASILEIRA: Lista de ESPÉCIES, DISTRIBUIÇÃO e CONSERVAÇÃO"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110706160944/http://www.dpi.inpe.br/referata/arq/22_Rafael_Bromelias/Bromelia_Mata_Atlantica.pdf |date=2011-07-06 }}; ''Rodriguésia 59'', February 2008; ppg 209−258; article−{{in lang|pt}}, abstract−{{in lang|en}} species lists−{{in lang|la}}. accessed 30 May 2016.</ref> It is native to southern [[Brazil]] in the states of [[Paraná (state)|Paraná]], [[Santa Catarina (state)|Santa Catarina]], and [[Rio Grande do Sul]]; and in eastern [[Argentina]] in [[Misiones]] province.<ref name=v>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=217861 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>Dimitri, M. J. 1974. La flora arborea del Parq. Nac. Iguazu. An. Parq. Nac. 12: 1–179.</ref><ref>Forzza, R. C. 2010; [http://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/2010  Lista de espécies Flora do Brasil] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150906080403/http://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/2010/ |date=2015-09-06 }};  Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro state.</ref><ref>Castellanos, A. 1944. Bromeliaceae Agentinae novae vel criticae. Lilloa 10(2): 445–467.</ref>
